scope: Private M6g 6 MHz virtual Real Mode prefix-free 81 36 disp16 imm16 XOR word RMW. Retained decoder late form +4, per-reference odd +2 READ/+2 WRITE, READ waits only, original final FLAGS and retirement together. Not write-buffer EU overlap, exact Intel issue phasing, arbitrary EA/LOCK/events, public profiles, physical calibration or FPGA fit/STA/RBF.
